svg.title: Chaining transformations with through
svg.desc: Five pre-allocated tensors connected by four cv operations, each writing into the next buffer and returning it, ending in a normalized float32 CHW tensor.

svg.text: Each operation writes into the destination you pass and returns it, so one step's dst is the next step's src. Nothing is allocated mid-chain.
